description: Production route inventory (CONTROL-DURABILITY). Every /api route the production app registers, grouped by how it behaves in production. Checked by src/tests/productionRouteInventory.test.ts. A refused group records its durable coverage: REPLACED (every route's work has a named durable route), PARTIAL (named durable routes plus the gap) or NONE (the gap). A replacement route is a route of the production app or of a route cutover router (src/server/routeCutover.ts); a cutover router is not mounted until its proposals are owner-approved.

kinds.VOLATILE_REFUSED: Backed by process-local (in-memory) state. Production refuses with the group's code, after authentication and scope checks, so nothing a restart or a second instance would lose is served or acknowledged. Needs a durable adapter.
kinds.DURABLE_GATED: A durable adapter exists but is off until its proposal is approved and applied and the switch is set; until then production refuses with the group's code.
kinds.PROVIDER_REFUSED: Depends on an external provider that is not commissioned; production refuses with the group's code.
kinds.RETIRED: Local password and identity routes retired in production in favour of the Supabase session bridge (410).
kinds.DURABLE: Reads or writes PostgreSQL or the durable session store through the server role. With the synthetic store in this test it reports its provider unavailable or answers from the synthetic session rows.
kinds.STATELESS: Computes only from the request or from a static reference catalog; it reads and records no case state.
kinds.DIAGNOSTIC: Liveness, readiness and administrator-only diagnostics; no client records.

groups.gap: No durable reviewer decision provider; durable case authority is next priority 1.
groups.reason: Reviewer approve and return-for-correction. The repository validates confirmation and reason, then refuses before any write because no durable reviewer decision provider exists.

groups.gap: No durable reviewer workspace; durable case authority is next priority 1.
groups.reason: The reviewer workspace snapshot is assembled from the process-local authority adapter.

groups.gap: No durable legacy review action; durable case authority is next priority 1.
groups.reason: Legacy review actions on the process-local authority adapter; refused before any write.

groups.gap: No durable case reviewer queue; durable case authority is next priority 1.
groups.reason: The reviewer queue is discovered from the process-local authority adapter, which is not a production discovery source.

groups.gap: Stage moves go through the cases router (advance, return, hold) under its stage evidence rules. Stage evaluation and invalidation, activation and free-form case updates have no durable route.
groups.reason: The case, its stages and stage history, stage transitions, blocks, reopening and activation on the process-local authority adapter.

groups.gap: Scanning runs through the development-only scan callback router with no scanner commissioned. There is no separate release step: the vault releases a document by independent staff review.
groups.reason: Case documents, scanning, release and OCR field review on the process-local authority adapter.

groups.gap: Evidence is held as vault documents and cited calculation inputs, traced from conclusions; there is no separate evidence record to create.
groups.reason: Case evidence records on the process-local authority adapter.

groups.gap: The Stage 04 authoritative record operation and duplicate resolution have no durable route; they need the reviewed-fact adapter and an authorized record operation (STAGE-04-PRODUCT).
groups.reason: Stage 04 records and duplicate resolution on the process-local authority adapter.

groups.gap: Reconciliation is the durable ledger's, which waits for the ledger switch (proposal 024). Case-level reconciliation runs have no route of their own.
groups.reason: Stage 05 reconciliation runs and resolution on the process-local authority adapter.

groups.gap: Blocking findings are durable diagnostics with acknowledgement. Free-form exceptions and Stage 14 notice resolutions have no durable route.
groups.reason: Exceptions and their resolutions on the process-local authority adapter.

groups.gap: Workpapers are book-to-tax workpapers with independent review. General case workpapers have no durable route.
groups.reason: Case workpapers on the process-local authority adapter.

groups.gap: The tax-engine routes replace them under independent review, QC and final authorization. Final authorization fails closed until the owner's QC and authorization policies are set.
groups.reason: Return generation, review, certification and approvals on the process-local authority adapter.

groups.gap: The signature package is prepared without signing. Signing and signature events need an e-signature provider and the owner's e-signature policy.
groups.reason: Signature requests and signing events on the process-local authority adapter.

groups.gap: IRS transmission, acknowledgements and government feedback need an authorized transmitter and providers (Stages 12, 13 and 16); production filing is not activated.
groups.reason: Filing, submission, acknowledgement and government feedback on the process-local authority adapter.

groups.gap: Stage 15 monitoring needs verified status, deadline and SLA providers and an SLA policy. Deadline escalation (Block 85) covers recorded deadlines only.
groups.reason: Stage 15 monitoring records on the process-local authority adapter.

groups.gap: Stage 08 planning needs reviewed facts, authoritative rules and an approved advisory policy.
groups.reason: Stage 08 tax planning on the process-local authority adapter.

groups.gap: Stages 17 and 18 need scoped engagement and consent renewal and an annual rollover contract. Adding a tax year to an engagement is the only durable action.
groups.reason: Stage 17 renewals, carry-forward and Stage 18 repeat on the process-local authority adapter.

groups.gap: Archiving needs the owner's retention policy. Report generation and artifact retrieval have no durable route.
groups.reason: Archive manifests, artifacts and reports on the process-local authority adapter.

groups.gap: No AI agent is commissioned; AI review on a case waits for commissioning under the governance controls.
groups.reason: AI review of a case on the process-local authority adapter.

groups.gap: The durable Stage 01 router covers the client questionnaire, submission and review. Equivalence with the legacy provisioning flow was not reviewed route by route.
groups.reason: Legacy Stage 01 onboarding on the process-local provisioner. The durable Stage 01 router is the stage-one cutover route.
Practice tasks, deadlines, staff assignments and workload held in in-memory services. The durable practice router covers tasks, deadlines and the engagement team.
Client message threads held in an in-memory service. The durable communications router covers threads and messages.
Service catalog, invoices and payments held in an in-memory service. The durable billing router covers the catalog, invoices and payments.
The in-memory background job queue. The durable jobs router (proposal 20261019240000) covers listing, enqueueing, retrying and cancelling, with worker claims fenced by lease tokens.

groups.gap: The durable requests are per engagement and tax year: clarification and amendment requests in the mounted collection router, document requests in the vault. Signature and payment requests have no request equivalent; signature packages and invoices carry that work.
groups.reason: Client requests (documents, clarifications, receipts, signatures, payments) held in an in-memory service.

groups.gap: The vault covers client notifications and preferences, and the practice router staff task-assignment notifications. Staff-triggered free-text dispatch is staff messaging and waits on the owner's general-record policy; staff notification preferences have no durable store; e-mail and SMS are not commissioned.
groups.reason: User notifications, staff dispatch and notification preferences held in an in-memory service.

groups.gap: The practice summary reports cases by stage (including Stages 11 and 12), open, overdue and ready-for-review tasks, document requests and receivables; the escalation view counts deadlines by level; the client detail is the per-client view. The summary reports active clients (Block 96). Paid revenue (billing, Codex Phase 15) is not reproduced. The in-memory bookkeeping backlog was always 0.
groups.reason: Practice analytics and the per-client command center, projected from the in-memory task, deadline and request services.

groups.gap: Adding a tax year to an engagement is the durable action. Nothing is carried forward automatically.
groups.reason: Annual rollover. The in-memory route returns a fixed description of what would carry forward and records nothing.

groups.gap: The practice search covers clients, cases, tasks and document requests, each by the actor's existing access rule. Invoices are not searched: the billing functions are redefined by Codex's Phase 15 work.
groups.reason: Operational search across clients, cases, requests, tasks and invoices held in in-memory services.

groups.gap: Retention periods and legal holds are owner policy and have no durable store. Archive verification compares a payload and a hash that the caller supplies; no archive manifest store exists, so nothing authoritative is verified.
groups.reason: Retention policies, legal holds and archive manifest verification held in in-memory services.

groups.gap: No durable client service views exist. The operations role may call only these four routes, and what client records it may see (tenant-wide or by assignment) is not decided.
groups.reason: The client service dashboard, search, conversation and request views project in-memory requests, communications, tasks and deadlines.

groups.gap: The practice summary and the escalation view are the durable reads; the dashboard's own layout of those figures is not reproduced.
groups.reason: The practice manager dashboard projects the in-memory task and deadline services.

groups.gap: No payment provider is commissioned, so there is no durable webhook.
groups.reason: No payment provider is commissioned and the billing service behind the webhook is in memory; production events are refused, not applied.
Ledger reads and writes. With TAXGUARD_LEDGER_STORE=durable they use SqlLedgerStore over the proposal-024 RPCs; otherwise production refuses rather than use the in-memory engine.

groups.gap: The book-to-tax router covers book-to-tax mapping. Accounting-provider sync and document matching have no durable route.
groups.reason: Book-to-tax, accounting-provider sync and document matching exist only on the in-memory engine; with the durable ledger selected they refuse with DURABLE_FEATURE_NOT_AVAILABLE. Book-to-tax has the book-to-tax cutover router.

groups.gap: Only ordinary contact fields are durable. Amendments are for sensitive identity fields (legal name, SSN, TIN, EIN, ITIN, date of birth, taxpayer type, entity classification, authorized representative); approving them depends on an identity verification policy (which fields need which evidence) that is not approved.
groups.reason: Profile amendments and the authoritative profile view use the process-local amendment engine; only ordinary contact fields are durable.
The accountant document-review store is process-local and nothing in production populates it. Durable Stage 02 document review is next priority 1.

groups.gap: The vault tracks required documents as staff-created document requests and lists the outstanding ones. The in-memory engine derives requirements from questionnaire answers and matches evidence to them; that derivation is tax content and is not reproduced durably.
groups.reason: The Stage 02 reconciliation snapshot is computed from process-local state.
The durable collection router (questionnaire, requests, requirements) calls the collection RPCs; it refuses clients without a server-recorded Stage 01 completion.
Evaluates the Stage 02 and Stage 03 gate functions over the snapshot in the request and returns the decision; it reads and records nothing and advances no stage.
Ordinary contact fields are updated through the durable profile store; unsupported fields are refused.
AI governance evaluation, kill switches and the control center read the production governance store; with no store they refuse with AI_GOVERNANCE_UNAVAILABLE.
The Supabase session bridge, the current identity and logout use the durable session store (taxguard_sessions).
Local password, registration, reset and verification routes; production answers 410 and requires the Supabase session bridge.
The accountant dashboard reads durable, tenant-scoped records for AAL2 staff sessions (read-only).
Lists the client ids reachable through the bookkeeper session grants, which are loaded from the durable staff assignments.
Read-only federal tax forms reference catalog compiled into the server; no client records.
Public liveness, readiness, and administrator-only provider readiness, metrics, alerts and route cutover status.
